A bold, monochromatic illustration features a tiny devilish girl rendered entirely in vivid red against a clean white background. She stands centered with her hands planted firmly on her hips, projecting exaggerated confidence and irritation despite her diminutive size. Her oversized head is framed by wild pigtails that curl outward with sketchy, energetic strokes, while a small three-point crown sits slightly off-center atop her messy hair. Large, sharply angled white eyes glare beneath heavy brows, and a tiny heart-shaped nose contrasts with a jagged frown lined with pointed little teeth. A thin devil's tail curls behind her dress, ending in a classic arrow tip. The rough brush texture gives the silhouette a hand-drawn, inked quality, while scattered paint splatters surround the figure, adding playful chaos and visual energy. To the lower right, the words "Miss Grumpy" appear in large, whimsical lettering accented with small hearts, reinforcing the character's comically sour personality. The overall composition is clean, graphic, and striking, relying on strong silhouette, expressive shapes, and high contrast to create an instantly memorable mascot-like character.
